retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast cinematic scene featuring figures on a deep red surface with long, dramatic black shadows cast by a single directional light source.
triggerTerms: harsh directional lighting with long shadows

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, moody composition dominated by a saturated red floor and pitch-black negative space, featuring figures in patterned clothing interacting with long, diagonal shadows.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between saturated red and deep black
Diagonal shadow lines creating rhythmic depth
Central figure in a leather chair as the focal anchor
Repetitive tiger-stripe patterns against solid color fields
coreInvariants: Deep red floor surface with visible texture
Long, parallel black shadows cast at a sharp diagonal

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Figures are clustered in the center-left, scaled to occupy roughly one-third of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The seated figure in the black leather chair provides the primary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal shadow lines from the bottom right toward the central figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space at the top and within the shadow bands.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red mid-tones with extreme value contrast in the shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single condensed sans-serif for utilitarian labeling.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of standard advisory labels.
Provides the necessary verticality and clean terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photo of a man in tiger-print pants sitting in a black leather chair on a red carpet, with two other figures standing nearby. Use a single harsh light source to create long, diagonal black shadows across the red floor. The top half of the image should be pure black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small, rectangular black and white advisory label in the bottom right corner using a bold condensed sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the red floor highly saturated?
Are the shadows long and diagonal?
Is the top of the frame solid black?
Is the text box in the bottom right corner?

mustRedesign: Exact text content of the label

mustAchieve: Rich texture on the red surface

postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between red and black
Ensure shadows are parallel and diagonal
Verify the presence of the black negative space at the top
Confirm the metadata label is small and corner-aligned
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Saturated Red Surface] + [Harsh Diagonal Shadows] + [Central Figure in Patterned Clothing] + [Black Negative Space Header].
